facts.fact: The Adwave customer case studies page lists 4 case study resources in the current view.
The Mountain Burger case study is categorized as a TV campaign case study and describes how diners recognized the restaurant after seeing its TV ad.
facts.quote: Mountain Burger shares how diners recognized the restaurant after seeing its TV ad.

facts.fact: The Kenny Patton case study is categorized as a TV campaign case study about promoting property listings with a TV campaign.
facts.quote: Kenny Patton shares his experience promoting property listings with a TV campaign.

facts.fact: The Farrow Harley-Davidson case study is categorized as a TV campaign case study about building local awareness in its market.
facts.quote: Farrow Harley-Davidson shares its experience building local awareness with a TV campaign.

facts.fact: The Kaimuki Dental case study is categorized as a TV campaign case study and reports what prospective patients said after its TV campaign.
